actual: When a GitHub Issue such as BUG-302 exists but the local BUG JSON is missing from main, scripts/aistock_issue_workflow.py run --bug-id BUG-302 fails with BUG record not found and does not provide an adopt/import/recovery path. Multi-window issue processing then stalls or may create duplicate BUGs. Expected: fail compactly with GitHub issue evidence and an exact safe next command to adopt or reconstruct the BUG record in an isolated worktree, without dirtying the root checkout.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
